name: Microgrid breaker closing-time compensation
summary: Accounts for the defined breaker operating-time model in its assigned synchronising command.
description: Accounts for the defined breaker operating-time model in its assigned synchronising command. Synchronising control compares two AC systems before their assigned connecting breaker closes. Voltage magnitude, frequency, phase relationship, breaker readiness and command authority are separate inputs to the closing decision.

In a microgrid reconnecting at its point of common coupling, a synchroniser can adjust the island reference while a separate permissive confirms the permitted relationship across the open breaker. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Phase evolution and breaker timing” at the input and “Compensated close request” at the output. The model requires validated breaker data.

Identify the two measurement sides and the equipment receiving any adjustment request. Closing limits, breaker timing and loss-of-measurement behavior require the approved synchronising design. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
